title: refactor: deduplicate multi-block Godement-Jacquet induction across GJFELeviMulti, GxMulti, and LdMulti
body:
Generalize `GroundTheory.Automorphic.GodementJacquet.MultiFEStatement` and its induction (`multiFEStatement_zero`, `multiFEStatement_succ`, `multiFEStatement_all`) in `GJFELeviMulti.lean` to carry a multiplicative shape predicate valued in a `CommMonoid` and an auxiliary topological hypothesis on the extra group factor `H`, and factor out the repeated Fubini computation inside `multiFEStatement_succ`.

Update `GJFELevi.lean` to instantiate the generalized `multiFEStatement_all` directly, and replace the duplicated multi-block induction proofs in `GxMulti.lean` and `LdMulti.lean` with instantiations of `multiFEStatement_all` (using `Polynomial ℂ` and `Multiplicative ℕ`, respectively).

Removed unused declarations:
- `UpperTheory.V.Z.ImaginaryQuadraticEtaCharacter.gxMulti_zero`
- `UpperTheory.V.Z.ImaginaryQuadraticEtaCharacter.gxMulti_succ`
- `UpperTheory.V.Z.Gam.ldMulti_zero`
- `UpperTheory.V.Z.Gam.ldMulti_succ`
